author: Luke Blommesteyn (lblommesteyn) and Saksham Batra (sakshambatra1)
method: Saksham Batra's priced_cpp C++ engine: negotiated congestion routing from scratch, then one long single-schedule simulated anneal (T0 20, no reheat cycles, 2-6 h) with exact per-net tree re-optimization; best seed per case. No routes from other entries.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (8 cores / 16 threads), 48 GB RAM, Windows 11 + WSL2; one case per worker, up to 16 workers at once
